note: What the generalism gate (generalism.py) still allows, each place with its reason: leftovers that a later change moves out, never a new exception. A place is a path prefix, or "path prefix: text" for the findings there whose text has it. An entry that matches nothing fails the gate: remove it.

sources-in-examples.examples/forge/: Forge, the workbench of C++ panels: its own program, to become a folder of JSON
sources-in-examples.examples/shared/Code: the "code" node type (an editor with syntax colours), to become a library type
sources-in-examples.examples/tempo/Visualiser: Tempo's visualiser surface, to become a library surface

host-sources.CMakeLists.txt: examples/shared/CodeEdit: the "code" node type, compiled into the host until it is a library type
host-sources.CMakeLists.txt: examples/tempo/Visualise: Tempo's visualiser surface, compiled into the host until it is a library surface

theme-outside-themes.modules/format/src/adapters/Layout.cpp: the palette of the screens the adapters convert, to become a token set in modules/themes
theme-outside-themes.modules/format/src/reference/: the format's reference: colours in its examples' text
theme-outside-themes.modules/format/src/windows/SecondWindows: an extra window's background when its screen gives none
